round_purpose: Feasibility pilot: can the training response upgrade from one-shot action selection (A0K) to CONTINUOUS data-mixture control? Not a selector fix; the continuous-control hypothesis test. Small-scale pilot only; no auto-expansion.

frozen_science_semantics.state_response: H=4 response via production run_adjoint_only on the event snapshot (shared-adjoint FULL_GRAD_DOT hhat_j, hvp_fp32=True), candidates = frozen 4 data groups (members of outputs/fr_decision_utility_v01/data_group_definition.json, which PARTITION the 3936-sample train pool: sizes 1038/973/987/938), j=1..4, no no-op candidate, NO cache, NO stale gradients, NO JVP scoring, NO block planning
frozen_science_semantics.mixture_space: pi_t lives on the 4-simplex over data groups. pi_0 = ORIGINAL DISTRIBUTION = empirical group proportions = [1038,973,987,938]/3936 = [0.263718,0.247206,0.250763,0.238321] (groups partition the train pool; this is exactly the native training distribution)
frozen_science_semantics.controller_update: every K=50 steps at event step t in {50,100}: (1) snapshot full state+RNG; (2) production H=4 response -> h_j (raw hhat, dV_score/dLambda at Lambda=0; NEGATIVE = beneficial); (3) q_j = softmax(-gamma_t * h_j) with gamma_t = 1/(std_j(h)+1e-12) frozen scale-free form (guard: std<1e-12 -> q=uniform); (4) pi_{t} = (1-alpha)*pi_before + alpha*q, alpha=0.1 FROZEN; (5) restore snapshot+RNG. pi held constant within each window: pi_0 governs steps 1-49, pi_50 governs steps 50-99, pi_100 governs steps 100-128. gamma form and alpha are frozen pre-GPU; tuning either by results is forbidden.
frozen_science_semantics.execution: per-micro mixture sampling: for micro m (0-based) in window w, component j ~ pi_w drawn from a DEDICATED deterministic generator (torch.Generator, seeded derive_stream_seed(train_seed+1704, 9090+w), CPU, isolated from global torch RNG so the dropout RNG sequence is identical across arms); batch_m = candidate_batches_for(derive_stream_seed(train_seed+1704, m), j, members_{j-1}, batch_size=4, n_micro=1)[0]. Arm A = native batches_from_train_pool(train_indices,4,train_seed+1704,256) (the original distribution). Arm B = component fixed j=1 for all micros (fixed-j1 continuous mixture = train on group 1 only). Training loss per micro = native mean over the drawn batch (NO gradient injection in A0L; the treatment is the data mixture, not a gradient perturbation).

frozen_environment.config: research/configs/e3c_confirmatory_v07.json (hidden 256 x 4 layers, seq 128, batch 4, accum 2, bf16, clip 1.0, lr 5e-4, planned_total_optimizer_steps=128, total_micro_steps=256)
frozen_environment.training_loop: e3c native AdamW recipe identical to A0K: setup_seed(train_seed) BEFORE init_model -> AdamW -> per-micro set_native_micro_lr -> autocast fwd/bwd /accum -> scaler.unscale_ -> clip_grad_norm_(1.0) -> scaler.step+update -> zero_grad. Optimizer, clipping, H, lambda untouched.
frozen_environment.eval: frozen validation_split.json v_score(64)/v_eval(64), a0g._val_loss_only, RNG-wrapped, every 10 steps at 10..128 plus final
frozen_environment.identity: all arms of a seed share identical init (setup_seed before init_model) and identical global-RNG/dropout sequence; cross-arm difference is the DATA COMPOSITION only (the treatment). Control events RNG-neutral (capture/restore around all response computation).

groups.A: native AdamW baseline (original distribution = full train pool)
groups.B: fixed-j1 continuous mixture (pi = one-hot on group 1 for the entire run)
groups.C: response mixture controller (pi updated at steps 50/100 per frozen update rule)

expansion_rule: PILOT ONLY - no seed expansion, no cadence changes, no alpha/gamma tuning regardless of results

equal_wall_clock_protocol.definition: per seed: T_C = measured wall of arm C full 128-step run (snapshot+response+restore+eval all included); A_wc and B_wc each consume the same budget T_C in the same session immediately after C (finish current optimizer step after exhaust, then final eval)
equal_wall_clock_protocol.gain_time: Gain_time(vs AdamW) = L_eval(A_wc @ T_C) - L_eval(C @ 128); Gain_time(vs fixed-j1) = L_eval(B_wc @ T_C) - L_eval(C @ 128)

evaluation_items: 1. Final Eval Loss (v_eval @128 per arm per seed)
2. Gain vs AdamW = L_A - L_C and L_A - L_B
4. Equal wall-clock gain per protocol above
5. pi trajectory (pi_0, pi_50, pi_100 per seed) plus per-window record

smokes_prefrozen.S1: arm A(2031) must bitwise-reproduce e3c v0.7 bank model_hash at steps 46/52 (proves mixture hooks are no-ops on the native path)
smokes_prefrozen.S2: determinism: arm B(2030) run twice -> identical trajectory tail model_hash
smokes_prefrozen.S3: one C control event cost summary

forbidden_this_round: selector repair or re-selection semantics (this round tests continuous control, not the selector)
gradient injection as the treatment (A0L treatment = data mixture only)
tune alpha or gamma by results; change K; add seeds; auto-expand
response cache / stale gradients / JVP scoring / block planning
use V_eval feedback to adjust the controller
retry_rule: infra/serialization-class retries only under same frozen contract/manifest; no env upgrades; no killing external tasks; no commit/push/reset; module hash changes logged in contract manifest BEFORE any results viewed

interpretation_cases.Case_A: C > B > A (final eval loss ordering, consistent across seeds) -> enter continuous response controller route
interpretation_cases.Case_B: C approx B > A -> consider response-discovered schedule (the response merely rediscovers what fixed-j1 already does)
interpretation_cases.Case_C: C <= A -> stop this route; analyze why response cannot directly control long-term mixture

deliverables: runs/ per-run step logs + per-event logs
stop_condition: after A0L reporting: STOP; no auto-expansion, no lambda/optimizer changes, no new rounds; wait for analysis
